_what: The Layers panel's choices, as DATA read by layers-panel.tsx. Each `sounds` row is a way to add a sound under the video and each `pictures` row a way to add a picture over it: its label (also the new layer's own name), its icon, which file families it takes, and the starting values of the layer it adds (`x`,`y` are where a picture's centre sits and `size` its width, as shares of the frame; `seconds` is how long a picture shows when its file does not say; null shows it to the end of the video). `loudness_lufs` is the level 'Even out the loudness' sets. Adding a kind of layer is one row here; nothing in the code names one.
